description: RdTools supplies Python methods for reproducible analysis of photovoltaic production time series. The national laboratory maintainers publish routines for estimating performance degradation and soiling losses, with documentation and notebooks for adapting analyses. Inputs are PV production records, and outputs include long-term degradation or loss estimates. The library accepts hourly or finer records as well as daily and weekly data, although its README says higher-frequency data produce better results. The geographic extent and monitoring period depend on the user's PV systems; this is not an observed generation dataset. Source is public and free under MIT, with installation through PyPI or a documented Pixi environment. The README reports tests on Python 3.10 and newer. Degradation and soiling estimates remain sensitive to data quality, record length and the selected method; this metadata review did not reproduce the cited validation studies. The package can support ageing assumptions and calibration of PV generation in capacity-planning models such as PyPSA (model-pypsa). The repository links separate publications for degradation, soiling and clipping detection, so users should cite the specific method used.
name: RdTools photovoltaic performance analysis
